notes.title: Hotfix 5/29
notes.content:
As expected, the engine change led to some unintended side effects! I've fixed the most dire ones:
[list]
[*]Fixed a rendering incompatibility error which was causing the game to crash on older machines
[*]Fixed an issue where the Oarfish was not showing up. If you had any and played before this hotfix, they may be gone now unfortunately, sorry about that! 
[*]Fixed a bug where the lights would refuse to change during the day
[*]Fixed an infinite money glitch where buying 100 golden pelagic dudes packs caused you to actually gain money instead of losing it
[*]Fixed bug where swap tank buttons still showed up on newly added fish.
[/list]

There are still more things to fix, but these should be the most important, and I wanted to publish this ASAP since it was game breaking for those of you on older machines.

Thanks for your patience! Again, I'm just one guy, I appreciate y'all for bearing with me through any growing pains.

Best fishes,
-Ben

notes.title: Chillquarium 1.3.7 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey y'all! I've been working for the last few months on migrating Chillquarium from Godot 3.5 to the current Godot 4.4. This is an under-the-hood engine upgrade that wound up taking longer than I expected, but should make the game easier for me to maintain and work on moving forward. Migrating the game led to a lot of unexpected bugs that I have tracked down, and while I think everything is working now, it is likely that there are more bugs that I have not yet seen! So if anything weird turns up, let me know in the Steam forums or in the #bug-reports channel on the Discord server. As always, bug reports are a huge help, thanks to those of you who have been posting them!

In the meantime, I tried to also address some of the common complaints I've noticed with the recent update.

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]  New fish-specific menu in collection with a cleaner interface for checking alt-painted variants (and also a 3D card shader effect stolen from a certain poker-based-roguelike). 
[*]   Performance improvements when adding and feeding fish, and navigating the tank menu and collection menu.
[*]   Added an extra freshwater and saltwater tank for the living-dexers out there
[*]   Added a mercy timer for mythics and painted mythics
[*]  Added some new visual particle effects for rainbow cards and tweaked the mythics particle effect to be cooler and less obnoxious 
[*]   Large amounts of money are now abbreviated
[*]  Costs in the shop are now obscured until you have reached a certain amount of money (so as not to spoil the surprise of "These cost *15 Quadrillion$!* etc.)
[*]   The game now saves whether or not gold packs were selected in the shop
[/list]
[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]   Fixed bug where offline income appeared to max out at 92 Quadrillion (this was actually just a visual bug, the real amount seemed to scale properly)
[*]   Minor tank menu layout improvements
[*]   "Equip" tank button removed from the shop because it was confusing
[*]   Switch tank button no longer appears if there is no other valid tank
[/list]

Happy fishing!
-Ben

notes.title: V1.3.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Here's a patch for a few of the most prominent issues and bug reports I've been getting based on the changes from the last patch. 
[h2]UX Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] The game now saves and creates a backup when it is closed via alt+f4 or the exit window button.
[*] Achievements now require all 26 fish rather than 25, which was confusing for a lot of people. (Don't worry, if you already had the achievement it will not be taken away!)
[*]Reduced volume when opening golden packs.
[*]Cards now warn you if the tank has the wrong water type.
[*]Card packs now display the water type they need in the shop.
[*]Scroll bars are now more prominent.
[*]Removed the sell fish hotkey because it was only ever pressed on accident.
[*]No longer need to wiggle the mouse to collect cards.
[*]Improved performance. This is just two words but it took a long time. Hopefully the game should be running more smoothly with full (and overfull, for the hackers out there) tanks!
[/list]
[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug where rare fish were much more prominent in golden packs.
[*]Fixed bug where golden cards would chime extremely loudly when the game was first opened.
[/list]
[h3]Note About Tank Space[/h3]
Conspicuously missing from this list is the addition of more tank space -- I realize this is very important to the folks who are trying to collect one of each fish and I want to add it, but things have been busy on my end and I want to implement a bit more involved of a change than just having an extra freshwater and saltwater tank. I am going to be out of town for a while, and I really wanted to get these UX improvements and bugfixes online ASAP rather than waiting until this was ready.

-Ben

notes.title: Chillquarium Version 1.3 Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Happy New Fish Day Everybody![/h1]

Hi y'all! I'm extremely excited to announce that after a bunch of work, Chillquarium version 1.3 is finally here! I am continually grateful to all of you for playing my game and letting me spend my time doing what I love, and as thanks I plan to keep adding stuff to Chillquarium for as long as people are interested in playing it <3

So without any further ado, here's a quick rundown of what's changed!

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3]New Stuff![/h3]
[list]
[*] Added 26 new fish in the "Pelagic Dudes" pack!
[*] Added 8 new tank decorations, doubling the amount in the game! Some of them even feature [i]mildly interactive elements[/i]!
[*] Added Golden Tickets, which allow you to directly purchase golden packs after raising all painted fish of a given pack!
[/list]

[h3]Minor Changes and QOL Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Alternate painted varieties are now displayed in the collection by hovering over the painted version of the fish, so you can tell which ones you're still missing!
[*] Golden packs now grant double the chance of producing rainbow fish
[*] Removed the upper bound on money
[*] Fish cards and packs now persist if the game is save+quit before they are added to the tank
[*] Added a "Sort by type" option in the tank menu so all fish of the same type are grouped together regardless of color variant
[*] Improved golden pack visuals
[/list]

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where money was sometimes set to negative value on launch
[*] Fixed bug where saltwater tanks displayed wrong name when first bought
[*] Sorting in tank menu now groups like fish together.
[*] Various minor optimizations
[/list]


One of the most consistent pieces of feedback I've received is that getting all of the gold fish achievements is far too grindy, and I agree! My original intention was just to have something to recognize the accomplishment of those few die-hard fans that were invested enough to open thousands of packs. What I've realized, though, is that including something as an achievement carries an implication of being worth your time, which was frustrating to many players. Less than 3% of players ever completed a gold row in their collection.

To remedy this, the most natural solution was to allow players to buy golden packs directly. The difficult part was to try to implement this in a way that doesn't cheapen the experience of getting natural goldens. My solution was to allow players to buy golden tickets for each pack, but only after all of the painted fish for that pack (not counting alternates) have been raised to adulthood. My hope is that this helps the achievement hunters of the world (like me!) to 100% the game without having to sell a portion of their soul to the RNG gods. 

Happy fishing! (and eventually, birding?)
-Ben

notes.title: Save File Integrity Hotfix V1.2.3
notes.content:
Quick patch notes that represent a surprising amount of development effort.

[list]
[*]Added a manual rollback system that lets you revert your save file to a previous session in case of save file corruption. 
[*]Older backups are sent to the system recycle bin rather than deleted completely.
[*]Fixed one more known issue that was leading to backup saves being corrupted.
[/list]

My hope is that this update should kill save file corruptions for good, because even if something corrupting happens it will only mean that the previous session is lost rather than everything. 

Just want to say a sincere apology to anyone who has lost their save file. This has been an issue that has plaguing the game since release, and every previous attempt I've made to fix it - as documented in the update patch note history- has reduced the number of occurrences but never eradicated them. In my opinion this kind of issue is unacceptable for a professional product, and it represents the growing-pains of me figuring out how to be a real developer instead of just a hobbyist.

Thanks again for bearing with me! My hope is that solidifying save file integrity will free up space for me to actually work on new content that adds to the game for everyone and makes it as good as possible.

Happy fishing!
-Ben

notes.title: Wing Haven announcement + Chillquarium Version 1.2 Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, it's been a while but I'm back with three big pieces of news!

[h1]I'm announcing Wing Haven -- the bird-themed sequel to Chillquarium![/h1]

Wing Haven is a game about populating wildlife sanctuaries with rare birds! It's a spiritual successor to Chillquarium, but I'm really excited about the variety that comes from having new biomes to build in and fill with native plant species. If you are interested, you can head over to the Steam page and add it to your wishlist, it does a lot for the Steam algorithm if you do!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2790850/Wing_Haven/

For the time being, Wing Haven is still in the early stages of development, and I'm super excited for where it will end up. For now that means that I don't have a target release date in mind -- it will be ready once it's ready. And don't worry, this doesn't mean I'm abandoning Chillquarium any time soon! I plan to continue development for both games in tandem moving forward. Which brings me to announcement number 2....

[h1]A new update for Chillquarium is ready! [/h1]

The main content of this update is an extra pack of fish to play with, but I've also added a few quality of life improvements that have been heavily requested.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43513165/4f8bfdba9b01fba4ac1508b0859d9ba5729e9595.png[/img]


[h2]Quick patch notes![/h2]

[list]
[*] Introducing Spring Pals, a new pack of freshwater fish to discover!
[*] Added an extra freshwater and saltwater tank, so you now have more room for all your fish!
[*] Added the ability to rename your tanks, finally!
[/list]

And last but not least...

[h1]Chillquarium is now 33% off as a featured Steam Daily Deal![/h1]
From now until June 9th, you can get Chillquarium for 33% off! That's the biggest discount the game has ever had, so now is the perfect time for those of you who've been holding onto the game in your wishlist to save some money!

Happy Fishing!
-Ben

notes.title: Chillquarium version 1.1 update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Merry Fishmas to you all!

I'm back, with a new update to Chillquarium! Things have been really busy at work but I'm finally ready to push a new build.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]Additional language support![/h2]

Chillquarium now supports Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, German, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and Russian! Huge thanks to the folks at IndieArk for their excellent translations!

[h2]New content![/h2]

[list]
[*] Added a mythic fish to each pack which is 10x rarer than the legendaries! (Not required for achievements)
[*] Added some additional painted colorings for some of the fish! These have a chance to appear once the standard painted fish has been discovered. Some fish have multiple alternate painted varieties!
[*] All baby sharks now have their own unique sprites, instead of sharing just one!
[*] 
[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life improvements![/h2]

[list]
[*] Added a "Reduced Clicking" option, which greatly reduces the number of clicks required to buy and open packs
[*] Added a "Buy Max" button, for buying as many packs as possible with a single click
[*] Gold fish now have a 25% chance to increase rarity level if all golden fish at the existing rarity are discovered. This effects stacks, so there is a 1/16 chance of a double-promotion.
[*] Various UI tweaks and minor bugfixes.
[*] 
[/list]

Implementing translations has taken a large amount of development time, but I'm very excited as it means Chillquarium can be experienced by a much greater variety of gamers. I hope you all have fun finding the new painted fish!

Best,
-Ben

notes.title: Update 1.0.4 patch notes!
notes.content:
[h1]Overview[/h1]

Hello everyone! With this patch I wanted to address some of the most important issues in the current build. Number one is that the percentage of players who are reporting corrupted save files and losing their hard earned progress is much higher than I would like to see. I have added some protections to prevent this from happening moving forward. I have also sped up the early game progression, and added a simple food upgrade system. In the future, I may rework this system to make it more interesting, but for the time being it should help to address the issues that active players had with progress being too slow. With this comes a number of highly requested quality-of-life features.

Before getting into the patch notes, I want to make a quick plea. I am a hobbyist solo developer finishing up grad school, but I would really like to pursue game development full time. If you like Chillquarium and want to support me, you can become a monthly supporter -- or just buy me a coffee -- here. 

[url=https://ko-fi.com/benreberdev]https://ko-fi.com/benreberdev[/url]

Game development is an uncertain field, and having steady community support can go a long way towards providing a sense of stability. Of course, you have all brought me tremendous value by buying the game, sharing your feedback, and leaving reviews on Steam (even the negative ones!) So your support is not required, please don't feel obligated! But if you would like to help out with development or just say thanks, it is hugely appreciated <3

[h1]What's New?[/h1]

[h2]Gameplay Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Rebalanced game pacing. Freshwater Friends now both earn and cost more, the first saltwater tank now costs less, and later saltwater packs cost more. Early game progression is now faster.
[*] Added a food xp upgrade so active playstyles are more effective.
[*] Added a couple of secrets :)
[/list]
[h2]Quality of Life Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Tank income is now displayed in the tank menu.
[*] Adult fish follow food less aggressively.
[*] Various minor UI tweaks.
[/list]
[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added an automatic backup save file to prevent players from losing progress in the event of a computer crash. 
[*] Packs are no longer lost when a new tank is bought.
[/list]

[h1]Beta Branch[/h1]
Again, I will be pushing all changes to the beta branch before making them live on the main build. In order to opt in to the beta branch, right click on the game in Steam and select "Properties -> Betas" and select the beta branch. Remember to join the beta at your own risk! I highly recommend beta testers [i]regularly back up your save files locally[/i]. Saves can be found at the following locations:
[list]
[*] Windows: C:\Users\ [you]\AppData\Roaming\Godot\app_userdata\Chillquarium\V7
[*] MacOS: ~/Library/Application Support/Godot/app_userdata/Chillquarium/V7
[/list]

Once again wishing you all the best with your shiny hunting :)

-Ben

P.s. You may have noticed that we skipped right from patch 1.0.2 to 1.0.4. There is no special reason for this, other than that I kinda... forgot which number we were on. Whoops.

notes.title: Week 1 patch
notes.content:
Hello everyone! It's been an extremely exciting launch week! I have been blown away by the response the game has received, and I'm so happy that you all seem to be enjoying the game I created! I have gotten so much feedback and constructive criticism and I felt that I should address some of the most common problems I was seeing as soon as possible.

[h1]Beta Branch[/h1]
In order to avoid publishing a change that breaks more than it fixes, I have created a beta branch for the game. I will be pushing all changes to the beta branch before making them live on the main build. In order to opt in to the beta branch, right click on the game in Steam and select "Properties -> Betas" and select the beta branch. 

This should be done at your own risk! If something is broken, it will cause problems only for beta testers, but their sacrifice will leave the broader playerbase safe from harm. Thank you in advance to our brave beta testers!

[h1]Patch Notes V1.0.1[/h1]

Here's a quick rundown of all the changes in this patch!

[h2]Gameplay Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced the time it takes for some fish from Freshwater Friends to grow up to speed up early game progression.  
[*] Made it so that adult fish still chase food but they no longer eat it.
[*] Increased the offline income cap to one week rather than 24 hours. 
[*] Added several parameters to certain fish to make them more accurately model real-life behavior, including bias towards the bottom or top of the tank and changes to swim speed. 
[/list]
[h2]Quality of Life Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Made it so that music now loops continuously by default. It can be reverted to sparsely come in and out through the settings menu.
[*] Moved the "Join Discord" button to the settings menu
[*] Turned "reset data" and "sell all fish" buttons red to indicate danger. 
[*] Added a warning to the "sell all fish" button the first time it is pressed so that people don't accidentally sell baby fish.
[*] Various minor UI tweaks.
[/list]
[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a rare crashing bug on the Windows build that caused the game not to launch.
[*]Fixed a bug where changes in the system time could result in negative values for player income and fish xp, potentially softlocking them.
[*]Fixed a bug on MacOS where some fish and decoration sprites did not load properly.
[/list]
[h1]Moving Forward[/h1]
I just want to say that I have heard your feedback loud and clear. By far the most common requests are for more interactivity with the food system, more gameplay benefits from cosmetic upgrades, and better balance for active playstyles. I would like to address these issues in the future to the best of my ability, but they will require more comprehensive system design, and development time, than the changes included in this hotfix. I hope you will have patience with me as I am a solo dev working on this project in my spare time while trying to finish grad school!

Good luck with the shiny hunting!
-Ben
